blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — State witness and former Public Works Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo on Wednesday testified before the Sandiganbayan that he never questioned the specifics of the millions of pesos he received from former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co. Bernardo took the witness stand before the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division on Wednesday where Co and former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) officials face graft case stemming from an allegedly substandard road dike project in Oriental Mindoro’s Naujan town worth P289.4 million.
